title: 556. Construct the Rectangle

examples.explanation: Among [1,4] and [2,2], the square has the smallest side gap.
A prime area only factors as 37 by 1.
This factor pair is the closest to a square.

hints: The width can never exceed the square root of the area.
Scan downward from the integer square root until a divisor is found; the first hit is the answer.
